about: The collecta of the formulary “Fourth Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are afflicted as our deeds deserve may be refreshed by the consolation of Your grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: by the consolation of Your grace
who lives and reigns with You
